references.text: David seeks God early in the morning, which mirrors Jesus' actions in Mark 1:35.
Speaks of waking up early to hear God's word, parallel to Jesus' early prayer.
Jesus withdraws to pray alone, a similar situation as in Mark 1:35.
Jesus withdraws to lonely places to pray, which is reflected in Mark 1:35.
